faq.q: Which password manager should I start with?
faq.a: Bitwarden Free — unlimited passwords and devices, open source, verified. If the experience feels too utilitarian after a couple of weeks, 1Password is the polish upgrade.

faq.q: How much should a family spend?
faq.a: $0.67–1.00 per person per month covers the credible options (Bitwarden Families to 1Password Families, verified). Migration effort, not price, is the real cost.

deals_hub.title: Verified Software Deals & Offers (2026)
deals_hub.meta_description: Password manager deals with honest verification statuses: offers we verified at official sources — with check dates — and an explicit 'not verified' where we found nothing. No invented codes.
deals_hub.policy: This page lists only offers we could verify at an official source, with the date we checked. Statuses: VERIFIED (checked at the official source), OFFICIAL (a standing policy documented by the vendor), UNVERIFIED (reported but not confirmed by us), NONE (we could not verify an active offer — we say so). We do not invent coupon codes, and we do not fake countdowns. Re-check cycle: 30 days or the badge degrades automatically.

deals_hub.no_codes_statement: Why no coupon codes here? Because every 'exclusive code' we could check for these brands was either an affiliate link dressed as a code or a fabrication. When a brand publishes a real code at an official source, we'll list it with a check date. Until then: the honest offers above beat fake urgency.
deals_hub.seasonal_note: Seasonal sales (Black Friday, New Year) genuinely move pricing for these vendors — expect verified updates here during those windows, not before they exist.
